title: Foundation UI Page-Family Runtime Parity Plan
overview: Defines the minimal shared page-family foundation for UI migrations without implementing individual reference pages. Establishes target route/screen/component boundaries for expedition-planning and dungeon-runtime, the runtime/headless view-model adapter shape, NavigationShell entry/return semantics, stable state-slot naming, interaction handoff conventions, and screenshot parity harness pattern.

rust_view_model.gap_reason: Rust contracts layer has no ExpeditionPlanningViewModel; frontend defines shape in contractTypes.ts. Must be added to contracts/viewmodels.rs with adapter in contracts/adapters.rs.
Rust contracts layer has no DungeonSelectViewModel. Must shape from CampaignState + dungeon config registry.
Rust contracts layer has no DungeonHintViewModel. Must shape from selected dungeon config + quest metadata.

navigation_semantics.return_semantic: Abandon expedition planning — no state mutation to campaign
navigation_semantics.continue_condition: launch-expedition intent succeeds → expedition transitions to dungeon-runtime family

rust_view_model.gap_reason: Rust contracts layer has no DungeonAssistViewModel. Must shape from active expedition hero states + camping skill registry.

Rust contracts layer has DungeonViewModel but no grid-based DungeonMapViewModel. Must transform Floor/Room graph from framework_progression into frontend grid layout with x/y coordinates, connection edges, and revealed/visited state.
Rust contracts layer has no DungeonInteractionViewModel. Must shape from RoomKind + InteractionRecord + CurioRegistry/TrapRegistry.

runtime_data_source.blocker: framework-gap: framework_viewmodels CombatViewModel may not expose all DDGC-specific fields (stress, death's door, skill cooldowns). Verify via adapter/viewmodel tests.

navigation_semantics.entry_condition: host.phase == Ready && flow_state == expedition && isLaunchable == true
navigation_semantics.return_target: Result screen (retreat) or Town (abandon from assist)
navigation_semantics.return_semantic: Retreat applies partial rewards/penalties; abandon discards expedition state
navigation_semantics.continue_condition: resume-from-return intent succeeds → apply rewards/penalties to CampaignState → clear active_expedition

runtime_adapter_shape.description: The headless-to-frontend adapter boundary that shapes Rust runtime state into frontend-consumable view models.

current_state.frontend_contracts: Complete: contractTypes.ts defines all view model shapes and intent types.
current_state.rust_viewmodels: Partial: BootLoad, Town, BuildingDetail, HeroDetail, Provisioning, ExpeditionSetup, Dungeon, CombatHud, Combat, Result, ReturnFlow exist. Missing: ExpeditionPlanning, DungeonSelect, DungeonHint, DungeonAssist, DungeonMap, DungeonInteraction.
current_state.rust_adapters: Partial: adapters.rs has town_from_campaign, dungeon_from_run_result, combat_from_framework, result_from_run, return_flow_from_state, boot_load_from_host. Missing adapters for the 6 missing view models.
current_state.bridge_integration: Synthetic: LiveRuntimeBridge creates hardcoded view models. No DdgcHost integration.
current_state.state_slot_naming: Stable: GameState uses active_expedition, active_combat, active_result, active_return_flow as ephemeral state slots. These names are contract-stable and used by both Rust state layer and TS frontend.

bridge_evolution.current: LiveRuntimeBridge creates synthetic view models directly in TypeScript.
bridge_evolution.target: LiveRuntimeBridge invokes DdgcHost via WASM bindings or JSON-RPC to fetch real view models shaped by Rust adapters.
bridge_evolution.transition_path: 1) Implement missing Rust view models + adapters → 2) Add representative-campaign methods to GameState for each new VM → 3) Wire bridge to call representative methods → 4) Replace synthetic data with real DdgcHost data
bridge_evolution.blocker_classification: game-gap — the bridge wiring is DDGC-specific and belongs in the frontend/ directory of this repo. No framework changes needed.

navigation_shell_semantics.description: Entry, return, and continue-flow semantics for the migrated pages.

active_expedition.lifecycle: Created at expedition launch, cleared on return-to-town
active_expedition.handoff: Expedition launch creates the run result; all dungeon-runtime screens read from this slot

active_combat.lifecycle: Created on combat entry, cleared on combat exit
active_combat.handoff: Combat screen receives encounter_id and initial vitals from expedition; updates through combat resolver

active_result.lifecycle: Created on expedition completion or combat end, cleared on continue-from-result
active_result.handoff: Result screen receives outcome, rewards, casualties from expedition/combat state

active_return_flow.lifecycle: Created on continue-from-result, cleared on resume-from-return
active_return_flow.handoff: Return screen receives hero vitals, dungeon metadata, and completion status

proceed-to-provisioning.state_mutation: Store selected plane/quest + party selection in transient planning state

confirm-provisioning.state_mutation: Deduct gold, mark heroes as on-expedition

launch-expedition.state_mutation: Create active_expedition via run_ddgc_slice or DdgcHost boot

enter-room.state_mutation: Update current room, mark visited, resolve room encounter
enter-room.validation: Room is accessible (connected + revealed) && canTransition() passes

continue-from-combat.state_mutation: Apply combat result, update hero vitals in active_expedition

resume-from-return.state_mutation: Apply rewards/penalties to CampaignState, clear active_expedition/active_result/active_return_flow, update roster

return-to-town.state_mutation: Discard transient planning state or abort expedition (with penalties if in dungeon-runtime)
return-to-town.validation: Not already in town && not during character-hit acknowledgement

screenshot_parity_harness.description: Pattern for verifying migrated pages match reference screenshots.

reference_image_paths.status: NOT_PRESENT — these directories do not exist in the repository. Must be created and populated with reference screenshots before implementation tasks proceed.

parity_verification_pattern.step_1: Capture reference screenshot from original Unity build or provided reference images.
parity_verification_pattern.step_2: Load migrated frontend screen with representative campaign data (via replay fixture or live bridge representative method).
parity_verification_pattern.step_3: Use Playwright to capture screenshot at identical viewport (1440x900).
parity_verification_pattern.step_4: Compare using pixel-diff or structural comparison (layout regions, text content, color palette).
parity_verification_pattern.step_5: Key interaction verification: assert that user actions (click, select, confirm) produce correct state transitions and view model updates.
parity_verification_pattern.acceptance_threshold: 30% review coverage — each page family must have at least one screenshot parity test and one interaction verification test before dependent implementation tasks are considered reviewable.

pre_implementation.description: Reference screenshot directories (reference/ref_image/跨际元契约/3位面探索 and 4副本) do not exist. Cannot establish screenshot parity baseline without reference images.
pre_implementation.resolution: Create reference directories and populate with reference screenshots from original game build or design mockups. If unavailable, document that parity will be verified against frontend smoke-test fixtures instead.

pre_implementation.description: Missing Rust view models for 6 frontend screens: ExpeditionPlanning, DungeonSelect, DungeonHint, DungeonAssist, DungeonMap, DungeonInteraction.
pre_implementation.resolution: Implement missing view models in src/contracts/viewmodels.rs and corresponding adapters in src/contracts/adapters.rs. Each requires serde Serialize/Deserialize and no framework-specific types in the JSON contract.

runtime_data.description: LiveRuntimeBridge creates synthetic view models with hardcoded data. No integration with DdgcHost for real campaign state.
runtime_data.resolution: Evolve bridge to call GameState representative methods (new_representative_expedition, new_representative_combat) via WASM or JSON-RPC, or at minimum align synthetic data with representative method outputs.

runtime_data.description: framework_viewmodels::CombatViewModel may not expose DDGC-specific fields (stress, skill cooldowns, death's door). Verify via existing adapter/viewmodel tests.
runtime_data.resolution: If framework_viewmodels lacks required fields, patch framework_viewmodels crate with regression test for generic combat view model fields. Do not add DDGC-specific fields to framework crate.

abstraction_boundary.description: The boundary between DDGC-specific content and framework crates.
abstraction_boundary.contract_json_rule: No framework-specific types (ActorId, EncounterId, RunId, RoomId, FloorId, CombatResolver, etc.) may appear in any view model serialized to JSON consumed by the frontend. All framework types must be mapped to String, u32, or DDGC-specific enums before serialization.
abstraction_boundary.current_compliance: Existing view models (TownViewModel, CombatViewModel, ResultViewModel, etc.) use String IDs and DDGC-specific enums. Compliance is verified by contracts_smoke_tests and ddgc_adapter_viewmodel_tests.
abstraction_boundary.required_compliance: All 6 new view models must follow the same pattern. Each must have a contract-boundary test that serializes to JSON and asserts no framework type names appear in the output.
abstraction_boundary.ddgc_content_rule: All DDGC-specific content (plane names like QingLong/BaiHu, dungeon configurations, hero classes, monster families) lives in DDGC_newArch. No DDGC-specific strings, IDs, or logic leak into framework crates.
abstraction_boundary.current_compliance_ddgc: Verified by no_ddgc_content_in_framework_crates integration test and MIGRATION_BLOCKERS.md rejection table.
abstraction_boundary.headless_boundary: The game runs headless. UI runtime behavior is outside the game runtime responsibility. The frontend is a separate TypeScript/SolidJS application that consumes contract JSON. The bridge between Rust headless runtime and TS frontend is the RuntimeBridge interface.
abstraction_boundary.state_slot_boundary: Ephemeral runtime state (active_expedition, active_combat, active_result, active_return_flow) is not persisted. Only CampaignState is the save/load boundary. This separation is already enforced in GameState.

thirty_percent_review_evidence.description: Every dependent implementation task must produce at least 30% review evidence before downstream tasks may proceed.
